description: Reviewed, immutable cross-language runtime contract shared by the .NET RuntimeContractTests and the Python test_runtime_contract.py. Each case pins the real TestScriptParser + TestScriptEvaluator + LocustIrCompiler behaviour against the Python locust runtime executing the same compiled IR. Do not regenerate from tests.

cases.name: crud
cases.description: CRUD: create (POST body from fixture), read, update, delete with a server-id variable flowing into later request URLs.

cases.name: post-search
cases.description: POST search collapses to <resource>/_search with the query string moved into a form-encoded body.

cases.name: history
cases.description: History lookup pinned through both a response-direction assertion (sourceId=hist) and request-direction assertions (sourceId=histReq).

cases.name: polling-success
cases.description: waitFor polls while the status is 202, then succeeds when a non-polling status arrives; attempts and outbound requests are pinned, sleep interval is 0.

cases.name: polling-timeout
cases.description: waitFor exhausts maxAttempts while still observing the polling status; the evaluator-compatible exhaustion message and attempt count are pinned.
cases.expectedPollingTimeoutMessage: Timed out waiting for job completion after 3 attempts (last status: 202)

cases.name: warning-only-assertion
cases.description: A failing warningOnly assertion emits no failed semantic event and does not fail its phase (Task 9 parity).

cases.name: skipped-assertion
cases.description: An assertionWhenResponseStatus gate that does not match makes the assertion inapplicable: no semantic event, phase not failed.

cases.name: any-of-pass
cases.description: An any-of group with one passing alternative aggregates to a single passing event under the first member's metric, with no per-member events.

cases.name: any-of-aggregate-fail
cases.description: An any-of group where every applicable alternative fails aggregates to a single failing event under the first member's metric.

cases.name: any-of-none-applicable
cases.description: An any-of group whose members are all gated off (condition never matched) aggregates to a single failing event; no member events.

cases.name: setup-failure
cases.description: A failing setup assertion fails the setup phase, skips every test, and still runs teardown.

cases.name: fixture-autocreate-autodelete
cases.description: Fixture autocreate replaces the fixture with the server response, a server-assigned id flows into an explicit test read, and autodelete uses the server-assigned type/id.
